verdict.rationale: None of the first-party Stagehand docs in the pack mention CAPTCHAs, so there is no documented stance: no automatic solving, human fallback, or explicit non-support. A single community comment praises 'built in proxies and captcha', but it is anecdotal, likely refers to the Browserbase host platform, and is not a documented stance. Another comment describes invisible CAPTCHAs blocking similar frameworks, not Stagehand behavior.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can rely on a documented captcha stance — automatic solving, human fallback, or explicit non-support — instead of silent task failures
